read_first: state/development/banks.json when unresolved fractional development or a lazy owner cursor is relevant
for rostered Sword Manor people, load state/house/tang.json plus the one bounded person-core registry rather than every individual component
write_order: identify the owner-specific unresolved interval from exactly one cursor: use bank resolved_through when that owner has a bank entry, otherwise use the owner development cursor
settle eligible activity with the normal capacity/recovery/relevance/difficulty law
add residual development credit to the owner-specific bank only when a residual or lazy cursor is needed
consume current point_cost repeatedly for whole capability gains and recompute cost after each threshold
retain nonnegative residual credit and advance the same authoritative cursor; when a bank entry exists do not also write a duplicate owner development cursor
update the authoritative learner/cohort/formation capability and rebuild a derived formation battle kernel when aggregate formation capability changes

for rostered House Tang people, settle each embedded individual-lite profile inside the one bounded person-core registry for the hours that person actually shares, then recompute the House cohort capability distribution as a derived summary
invariants: No progression without time and opportunity.
A resolved_through cursor is proof of completed settlement, never a mirror of global campaign time.
Global time may outrun a lazy owner cursor only while a covering causal host proves the unresolved interval safe; safe_through permits deferred work and never erases it.

No owner, cohort, formation, or institution cursor may advance across an interval until every authoritative elapsed-time subsystem covering that owner has settled the interval or explicitly established zero eligible activity.

Trainable capability values and learning aptitudes have no hard maximum; 200 is a reference threshold only, and earned progression above it remains legal under normal point-cost and diminishing-return rules.
A bank stores development credit already earned from resolved eligible activity; it never stores unearned scheduled hours.

Development-bank residual credits persist as nonnegative JSON numbers under the registered owner schema; canonical command and receipt aggregates may use decimal strings without changing the owner representation.
Credits never transfer between owners or capability targets.
Each owner has exactly one authoritative development cursor; a bank entry's resolved_through supersedes and forbids a duplicate writable cursor on that exact character.
Aggregate process settled_through never erases an owner-specific unresolved development interval.
Routine training cannot manufacture field experience, combat experience, command experience, promotion, or qualification gates.
Replacement personnel do not inherit veteran experience for free.
Every rostered House Tang member owns persistent individual-lite capability and development state; training cohorts are scheduling/organization containers and derived summaries only.

A shared House training interval may be settled efficiently in one bounded registry write, but each member receives only the development earned by that member and keeps independent residual credit, technique progress, and promotion evidence.
Changing a House cohort assignment or summary never changes an established individual profile except through lawful causal progression.
